find_tests_for_inputs: find tests for a list of input paths using a lit configuration object and caches
load_test_suite: load a unittest test suite from input paths by discovering and wrapping lit tests
get_test_suite: get the test suite containing a given item path and its relative path inside the suite
get_tests_in_suite: get all tests within a test suite directory recursively, yielding test objects
get_local_config: get the local configuration for a path within a test suite, inheriting from parent configs
